working_geometry_plain: The working Phase 2 geometry is PEPS3D-anchored finite response-quotient carrier geometry. After R_replay_K, the earned object is a finite table of boundary/interior replay signatures over explicit PEPS3D anchors, finite shapes, finite bond dimensions, and finite order-sensitive local paths. It is not the physical manifold and it does not open Hopf/Weyl, terrain, substages, flux, Xi/Phi0, Axis0, or any downstream physics/game-theory layer.
